parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter will be removed in the future.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than **0** and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**. Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SubscriptionInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the DescribeSubscriptionInstances operation to query the instance ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-consumer-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-size 30 --page-num 1 --subscription-instance-id dtso5xx5t9u19e0000 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-aekz4us4iruleja --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
